Complete the previously blocked checks in the ORIGINAL Rotkiewicz 1983 paper, rather than relying on quotations:
1. Verify title, printed page range and the conventions on signs and Jacobi symbols. Resolve which Jacobi-symbol orientations are actually in Theorems 3 and 5, noting whether a discrepancy with later Luca-Walsh/Yuan-Li quotations is a parameter convention or an error.
2. Inspect the whole paper's relevant theorem statements and supporting formulas for our parameters. Look for any stronger result about primitive cyclotomic factors, arbitrary composite indices, square classes, or quadratic characters that implies our exact criterion or our general target-three norm conjecture. Give page/theorem numbers and a precise applicability argument, including exceptions. Distinguish first and associated Lehmer sequences and whole terms from primitive factors.
3. State what this closes in the literature review and what remains unknown. Your earlier headline 'the 1986 Patras chapter is irrelevant' was stronger than the underlying evidence: only its zbMATH review was inspected. Retain that limitation unless you can actually read its full text; 'no direct relevance found in the review' is justified, a full-paper clearance is not.

Notation: lambda=sqrt(3)+sqrt(2). At odd n our U_n=(lambda^n+lambda^-n)/(2sqrt(3))=1,9,89,881,... . It is first Lehmer at (L,M)=(8,-1), roots lambda,-lambda^-1, AND associated Lehmer at (R,Q)=(12,1), roots lambda,lambda^-1. First Lehmer at (12,1) instead gives W_n, not U_n. For odd e>1, N_e=prod_(d|e) U_d^mu(e/d)=Phi_e(lambda,-lambda^-1)=Phi_(2e)(lambda,lambda^-1). Ordinary Lucas with x_(n+2)=10x_(n+1)-x_n gives U_n*W_n at odd n. A primitive divisor count without odd valuation does not prove nonsquareness.

Exact criterion: ell=2^t-1 prime, odd t>=3, w(p)=2^(v2(p^2-1)-3). If the weights of the distinct odd primes p dividing e sum to 2^(t-2), then Legendre(N_e/ell)=-1 for every positive exponent vector. The separate geometric application excludes sqrt(C_e^2+8) from every cyclotomic field. General source-order exclusion remains unproved in the project.

Deliver a short plain-English outcome first, then technical comparisons, precise citations into the supplied PDF, and ready-to-use replacement paragraphs for LITERATURE_REVIEW132.md and ledger updates. If no matching theorem is found, report only that bounded finding, not a novelty claim. Identify unread remaining sources. End with standalone [DONE].
